verdict.rationale: Whether a software product's source is available under an open license is a fair question for an AI code review platform, so the axis applies. The pack never mentions a public repository, source availability, or an open-source license. Self-hosted and air-gapped deployment and the .pr_agent.toml config file describe deployment and configuration, not readable source under an open license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
